design: Tier 1, no migration (the credit columns exist since 0117). D1: _worker_lines adds ai_nano_aiu and premium_requests sums and credited_calls (spawned, total null, a credit figure set); unmeasured_calls narrows to spawned calls with neither. D2: the project's credit figures add the worker lines' sums in Python (None + n = n), so project = agents + workers by construction; agents and conversation_usage stay turns only; the budget is unchanged (credits are never budgeted). D3: preferred_display order allowance, api_equivalent, credits, tokens, unavailable; credits = {kind, label 'AI credits', runner 'copilot', ai_nano_aiu, premium_requests}. UI: the union gains the kind; accountingDisplayLabel reads 'Copilot AI credits · no allowance reported'; a worker chip shows tokens when known, then credits and premium requests, then unavailable calls; the caption counts measured + credited + unmeasured worker calls. Rejected: credits before api_equivalent (demotes a dollar figure on every mixed project); credits only when every turn is Copilot (flaps on one Claude turn).

problem: Work-PC drive (trial DB workpc-drive, proj-d73f8848ee60): 20 Copilot turns charged 19.0 premium requests and 154.00 AI credits; a checkpoint and its probe charged 2.0 and 1.92 more, recorded on worker_invocations and read by nothing, so GET /accounting reported 19 and 154.00 instead of 21 and 155.92. A Copilot one-shot call reports no tokens, so slice A's worker line counts it as an unmeasured call and shows nothing it spent. preferred_display has no credits kind: with no allowance reading and no cost, the all-Copilot project's headline read 'Tokens'.

requirements.rationale: A Copilot worker call spends credits, not tokens; calling it unmeasured hides what it cost.
requirements.statement: Each `workers` line MUST carry the sum of its kind's AI credits and premium requests (null when no call reported one) and a count of credited calls, those that ran and reported credits but no token count; such a call MUST NOT be counted as unmeasured.

requirements.rationale: The project's spend in Copilot's units must equal what its turns and worker calls charged.
requirements.statement: The project's AI credits and premium requests MUST be its turns' sums plus its worker lines' sums, while the per-agent and per-conversation figures stay turns only and no credit figure counts toward the token budget.

requirements.rationale: The headline should name the unit the project's data is in (wpc6-c: follow the data, not the dominant runner).
requirements.statement: When the project has no allowance reading among its recent turns and no reported cost, but has AI credits or premium requests (from turns or worker calls), preferred_display MUST be the kind `credits`, naming runner copilot and carrying both figures; a project with neither keeps its previous kind.

in_scope: worker lines: ai_nano_aiu, premium_requests, credited_calls; unmeasured narrows to calls that reported neither
project credit totals include the worker lines (agents and conversations stay turns only)
preferred_display kind credits between api_equivalent and tokens
the dashboard label, the worker chips and the caption count
non_goals: Budgets in credits or premium requests (wpc6-a: tokens only)
Estimating tokens for a Copilot one-shot call
The JSON 'null' allowance text (unchanged; a control test pins that it is never read as an allowance)

summary: Each `workers` accounting line carries its kind's Copilot credits and a count of credited calls (credits but no tokens), so a Copilot checkpoint is no longer 'usage unavailable'; the project's AI credits and premium requests include the worker calls; and `preferred_display` gains a `credits` kind, ranked after a reported cost and before tokens, so an all-Copilot project's headline names its real unit (F665 / WPC-6; decision fix-D2, wpc6-a..c; wpc6-d and wpc6-f built as recommended, still open). Slice B of D2; slice A is worker-spend-counts-against-the-budget. Re-authored from openspec copilot-spend-is-counted-in-its-own-units.
